deliveryNotes: The question-type menu represents format information, not an exercise/test.
The title What skills are tested? is educational; it is not a proficiency score.
Listening applies to both IELTS Academic and General Training; this Reading list is specifically Academic Reading.
Only show content supported by the mapped source rows and the linked official format pages.

questionTypes.title: Multiple choice
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Select the correct option for a question or sentence ending. Some items require more than one selection; check the instructions.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Understand both particular details and the central ideas of what you hear.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Choose exactly the number of answers requested.

questionTypes.title: Matching
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Connect items mentioned in the recording to the relevant options or descriptions.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Follow conversations, locate details and understand connections between facts.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Look for relationships, not only repeated words.

questionTypes.title: Plan/map/diagram labelling
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Complete labels on a plan, map, picture or diagram using the available options or wording from the recording.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Follow descriptions of locations and relate spoken information to a visual.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Check whether to choose from listed options or type words.

questionTypes.title: Form/note/table/flow-chart completion
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Fill missing information in a form, notes, table or a sequence of process steps.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Identify key facts, categorize details and follow an explanation or process.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.

questionTypes.title: Sentence completion
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Fill gaps in sentences using information from the recording.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Recognize essential details and relationships such as cause and effect.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Use the permitted number of words or numerals.

questionTypes.title: Short-answer questions
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Write short factual answers based on the recording; some questions request more than one item.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Identify specific information such as times, prices or locations.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Use only the requested number of answers and respect word limits.

questionTypes.title: Multiple choice
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Choose the option or sentence ending best supported by the passage; some questions request multiple answers.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Read for precise facts or the overall meaning of a section.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Read the instructions to determine the number of choices.

questionTypes.title: Identifying information (True/False/Not Given)
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Classify each statement as supported, contradicted, or not established by the passage.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Distinguish explicit evidence from missing information.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Use the passage, not personal knowledge.

questionTypes.title: Identifying writer views (Yes/No/Not Given)
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Decide whether a statement agrees with, opposes or is not addressed by the writer’s view.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: A missing opinion is not automatically a disagreement.

questionTypes.title: Matching information
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Locate a requested fact, explanation or example in the correct paragraph or section.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Scan for specific details and reasons.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: A paragraph can sometimes be used more than once when allowed.

questionTypes.title: Matching headings
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Assign an appropriate heading to each paragraph or section, with extra headings left unused.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Identify paragraph-level main ideas rather than individual details.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Some headings are distractors; a heading is not reused.

questionTypes.title: Matching features
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Link statements to named people, things, dates or other features in the passage.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Trace relationships between facts and opinions using scanning and careful reading.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Options may repeat if the instructions permit.

questionTypes.title: Matching sentence endings
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Complete sentence beginnings by choosing the ending that matches the passage.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Understand main ideas expressed across a sentence.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: There are more endings than beginnings.

questionTypes.title: Sentence completion
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Use words from the passage to complete sentences with gaps.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.

questionTypes.title: Summary/note/table/flow-chart completion
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Complete a summary or structured outline using passage words or an allowed option list.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Understand details, key ideas and what type of word fits a gap.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Answers may not follow passage order.

questionTypes.title: Diagram label completion
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Supply missing labels on a diagram using information from the passage.
questionTypes.skillsTested: Connect a detailed written description to its visual representation.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Answers need not occur in textual order.

questionTypes.title: Short-answer questions
questionTypes.whatIsInvolved: Answer factual questions using short words or numbers from the passage.
questionTypes.questionCount: Variable: there is no fixed number assigned to this type.
questionTypes.practicalNote: Observe word limits and the question instructions.
